dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Forgot your lines? It's okay, you don't have to force yourself.

dialogues.speaker: "Muchih"
dialogues.text: Muchih was originally a hunter stationed at Villa Guiztli, but a few days ago, they made Muchih work here as a lifeguard, so Muchih's not too familiar with this place... Muchih's sorry.

dialogues.speaker: "Muchih"
dialogues.text: Anyway, this is Vil— I mean, Wavey Bay, and all you need to do is jump into the ocean and have yourself a blast! Muchih will be in charge of keeping you safe. Muchih's memory isn't so good, but his eyesight and swimming are top-notch!

dialogues.speaker: "Muchih"
dialogues.text: Muchih will keep an eye on everything that goes on in the sea. Whether it's jellyfish, sharks, or even guests, Muchih can fish 'em all up.
